capabilities: Display an iBooks-style bookshelf of Douban and Fanqie entries with covers and progress
Search Douban (books, movies, TV, music) and Fanqie and add entries to the shelf
Read Fanqie chapters with per-chapter progress, bookmarks, and keyboard navigation
Insert excerpts with source, chapter, and obsidian:// back-jump links into notes
Export single chapters or whole books to notes on demand
disambiguation: Not a read-later list or a book downloader; it shelves, reads, and excerpts books you add yourself, and chapter text only enters the vault when you export it.
extras: Windows desktop only (the Fanqie sidecar is an exe); the sidecar must be downloaded manually from a separate repository (Yolkbun/ex-libris-sidecar) and is never auto-installed or updated; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; GPL-3.0-or-later, for personal study and research, not affiliated with ByteDance/Fanqie, Douban, Obsidian, or Clarivate/Ex Libris; no telemetry, and Douban public search is rate-limited.
motivation: The author sees the shelf as more than file storage: it is a way to walk back to the world of books you have read, and the plugin exists so read books can be found again when needed.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to shelve Douban books and media or read Fanqie novels and pull excerpts with back-links into your notes.

relations.evidence: optional read-only linkage with obsidian-douban can be toggled in settings
